name: Enraged Spirits
summary: In the Charred Vale, spirits of flame and stone rage after the Venture Company’s destruction. Fire and heavy machinery laid waste to the basin, and the freed elementals overran it. Alliance champions are asked to quell them so the wounded land may heal under Elune’s grace.

sections.title: A Scorched Tragedy
sections.body: The Charred Vale was once a lush haven in Stonetalon. The Venture Company’s greed turned it to ash as goblins drove to log the forest and strip its resources. They used incendiary devices and heavy machinery, setting the canopy ablaze. Their actions destroyed the trees and shattered the fragile elemental balance beneath the earth.

sections.title: Unleashed Fury
sections.body: The Venture Company’s work stirred ancient spirits of fire, stone, and fury from the depths. The enraged elementals turned on the goblins, drove them back, and claimed the smoldering crater. Kaela Shadowspear says nature cannot begin to recover while these chaotic elementals remain.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Enraged Spirits?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel in the Stonetalon Mountains, gives this charge to Alliance adventurers seeking to aid the land.

faq.q: Why are the fire elementals rampaging in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: The Venture Company clear-cut and burned the forest with destructive machinery. Their methods disrupted the earth and freed dormant spirits of flame, stone, and rage, which overran the area.

faq.q: What happened to the Venture Company in the Charred Vale?
aliases: did goblins die in charred vale
faq.answer: The goblins set the forest ablaze, and their actions unleashed elementals more dangerous than they expected. The furious beings overwhelmed their operations, leaving ruined camps and blazing wreckage.
Smoldering Embers are burning remnants collected from fire elementals destroyed in the Charred Vale. They are brought to Kaela Shadowspear as proof that the elementals have been culled.

faq.q: Can the Charred Vale ever recover?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear believes the land cannot recover or feel Elune’s blessing while hostile elementals roam the ashes. Removing them is the first step toward healing.

faq.q: Where is the Charred Vale located?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale lies in the southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, among blackened earth, burned timber, and roaming elemental spirits.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see the Charred Vale’s devastation as a heartbreaking wound to Kalimdor’s sacred wildlands, inflicted by unchecked industrial greed.
As a druid, you see the rampaging fire elementals as a grave disruption of nature’s balance. Active intervention is needed before life can return to the soil.
As a shaman, you know the elementals’ wrath is an agonizing reaction to mortal miners and loggers recklessly exploiting the earth.
As an Alliance member, you work through night elf sentinels in Stonetalon to contain the chaos caused by goblin cartels and restore safety to the mountain passes.
